g.text: Complete random-labelled target recovery and rho
60 public targets · B=8…128 · r approximately 8 B³ · fresh charged pools, up to four attempts
Five measured rounds after a warmup; finite failures/censoring retained.
B pullback(s) pairs(s) rho(s) IC completed / measured target units
Time includes public validation/generation/rejections, prior misses, lazy datum construction/validation,
norm/GCD, roots, witness recovery and original-curve scalar checks. All four misses mean censored, not solved.
Rho: prime_fast, negation, one thread, table_bits=4, walkers=8, dp_bits=0; no optimal-tuning claim.
Process startup/output and parent/child RSS are separately retained. No L2 or signed replay. [pcc:unverified]
